stories.summary: Fix Skeleton Overlay Jitter with React.memo and Frame-Change Detection

details.user_story: As a user, I want the skeleton overlay to render smoothly without jitter during video playback, so I can accurately analyze my swing mechanics.
details.context: The overlay was re-rendering 60 times per second (on every timeUpdate event) even when the frame data hadn't changed. This caused visual jitter and wasted rendering cycles. The issue was excessive state updates and missing memoization.
acceptance_criteria: Overlay re-renders only when frame data actually changes (30fps for typical videos).
No visual jitter during continuous playback.
Smooth overlay tracking when seeking/scrubbing through video.
No performance degradation or visual artifacts.
details.technical_details: Applied React.memo to SkeletonOverlay component with custom comparison function to prevent re-renders when landmarks haven't changed. Added frame index tracking with useRef in App.js to skip redundant state updates. Reduced re-render frequency from 60/sec to video FPS (~30/sec).
edge_cases: Container resize mid-playback should trigger re-render.
Frame index reset needed when switching videos.
Backwards seeking should correctly update overlay.
